faqs.question: I run a local clinic, showroom, or retail store. How fast can we see real walk-in and call growth?
faqs.answer: We launch your upgraded mobile booking/catalog hub, smart QR review system, and Google Business Profile optimization within 14 to 21 days. Most local partners see measurable increases in direct calls, WhatsApp inquiries, and Map Pack #Top rankings within the first 30 days.

faqs.question: Do you use WordPress templates or build custom code from scratch?
faqs.answer: We engineer custom applications using React 19, Next.js 15, TypeScript, Node.js, Python, and Java 21. That is why our platforms load in under 100ms, achieve 99+ Core Web Vitals scores, and never suffer from plugin crashes or template bloat.

faqs.question: Who owns the source code, domain, WhatsApp number, and ad accounts?
faqs.answer: You own 100% of your GitHub repository, domain, cloud hosting, WhatsApp Business API account, and Meta/Google ad accounts from day one. We never hold client infrastructure hostage.

faqs.question: How does the 15% Referral Commission Program work?
faqs.answer: Simply introduce a business owner, clinic, showroom, or founder who needs a website, custom software, AI automation, or growth marketing. When they sign their project with SkyLine, we transfer a direct 15% cash commission of the initial contract value to you via UPI or bank transfer within 48 hours of invoice clearance.

faqs.question: Will the WhatsApp AI bot feel robotic to my customers?
faqs.answer: No. We train the workflow on your exact services, pricing, brochure PDFs, and tone of voice (including English and Hinglish support). It answers common questions immediately, captures budget/requirements, and hands over warm leads to your human team on WhatsApp with full context.
